# Bell Recruitment

> Bell Recruitment is a specialist FMCG recruitment and executive search consultancy based in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Founded in 1999 by Julie Bell, it has over 25 years' experience placing commercial, sales, operations, technical, procurement, production, supply chain, finance and engineering talent for food, drink and consumer brands across Northern Ireland, Ireland and the UK. The search starts within 24 hours of receiving a job description.

Founder and CEO: Julie Bell, who spent a decade working within FMCG for brands including Pepsi, 7UP, Ballygowan water and Budweiser before founding the business.
Contact: julie@bellrecruitment.net, +44 28 9031 1211, 24 Mount Charles, Belfast BT7 1NZ, United Kingdom.

- [Blogs](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/): FMCG hiring and career advice.

- [How to choose an FMCG recruitment agency in Ireland](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/fmcg-recruitment-agency-ireland/): Seven questions to ask an FMCG recruitment agency before you brief it.
- [How to attract top FMCG talent](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/how-to-attract-top-fmcg-talent/): Seven steps for employers hiring FMCG sales and commercial people.
- [Preparing your CV for a commercial role](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/preparing-your-cv-for-a-commercial-role/): What to include on a commercial FMCG CV and how to show results.
- [Executive search vs recruitment](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/executive-search-vs-recruitment/): How the two services differ and when to choose each.
- [Upload your CV](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/cv-upload/): For candidates to register with Bell Recruitment.
